source: The title column of the observed tracker's issues table, read with the work-item statement and pinned to its revision.

detectorPolicy.use: every detector, unchanged, over the whole title

activeContent: the observed-body active-content scan, unchanged; any finding withholds the title
classificationOrder: withhold as unclassifiable a value that is not text, is empty, exceeds maxLength UTF-16 code units, or holds a C0 or C1 control character or a lone surrogate
run every detector; any match withholds the title as secret-matched
run the active-content scan; any finding withholds the title as active-content
withhold as unclassifiable a title whose screening fails
admit the title's text, served as is and rendered escaped

withheldRecord.digest: SHA-256 of the title's UTF-8 bytes, or null when the tracker held no text

boundaries: No title is sent to a model provider.
No other free-text field of a work item is admitted by this policy.
No detector or scan is loosened by this policy.
